summary.text: Nancy Guenst is a Democratic member of the Pennsylvania House of Representatives from District 152, having taken office on December 1, 2020, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A U.S. Army veteran, she is a former mayor of Hatboro and the president of Designs In Stone, Inc.

paragraphs.text: Guenst was born in Abington, Pennsylvania, served in the United States Army from 1977 to 1979, and earned a high school diploma from Hatboro-Horsham Senior High School.
Her career experience includes working as the president of Designs In Stone, Inc.
In a Ballotpedia survey, Guenst said that after returning home from the Army she served two terms on Hatboro Council and then became Hatboro's first female mayor.
She said she ran for the state House in 2020.
In the 2023-2024 session she was assigned to the Children & Youth, Ethics, Professional Licensure, State Government, and Veterans Affairs & Emergency Preparedness committees.
In the survey, she said she is passionate about the environment, helping others and working with all.
